metadata.name: PoissonNeuron
metadata.author: Gerstner, W. et al.
metadata.description: Homogeneous Poisson binary-bin event generator at rate lambda

threshold.probability_expression: 1.0 - exp(-(((rate_hz if I < 0.0 else I) * dt_ms) / 1000.0))
threshold.description: P(at least one event in dt) = 1 - exp(-rate_hz * dt_ms / 1000); multiple within-bin events collapse to one bit

extensions.use_case: Input layer spike generation for SNN benchmarks

profile.notes: Event-only bin process: the probability of at least one event per bin is decided by the model-scoped LFSR16; dt_ms is the bin width bound to integration.dt, so a step override moves the bin width with it.
